name: Ask the Agent
description: Give OAIY's agent a task and wait for its answer.
doc:
Hands a task to the agent in OAIY's window, which does it with its own tools (files, the web, pictures, the calendar, texts...) in a conversation of this flow's, and gives back its answer as the output.

The task is the Task input when connected, else the Task setting; {{input}} in the setting is the Task input. Anything on the Context input goes with it.

The answer is the agent's last reply: ask for exactly what the rest of the flow needs.

Runs in the OAIY app (the agent must be open there).

properties.name: Task
properties.description: What the agent should do (used when the Task input is not connected; {{input}} is the Task input)

properties.name: Conversation
properties.description: The agent's conversation the tasks go to (a tab in the Agent page)

properties.name: Wait (minutes)
properties.description: How long the flow waits for the answer
